content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently abroad handling system maintenance for a setup from my company, which uses a [product_name] module. I've switched to a new computer since I originally programmed the [product_name] and do not have [product_name] installed on it. Although I own a license for the software, I can't figure out how to download it. Is there an online version available? Thanks for your support. Best regards, [user_name]

I'm not sure which license you're referring to. For [product_name], there are no license keys as used in some other software from [company_name]. The purchased CD/DVD itself functions as your license. There is no full downloadable version of [product_name], only upgrade files, which require an existing installation or the original CD/DVD present in the drive.
You might consider ordering another copy of the DVD from an online store or having someone ship your DVD to your current location.
Yes, I was referring to a purchased CD. Thanks for clarifying!
I've managed to arrange delivery of my CD to my current location. Thank you for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users needing to reinstall [product_name] face challenges when the original installation media is inaccessible, such as when working abroad or after changing computers. The absence of a downloadable full version complicates portability and system recovery in such scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to download a complete version of [product_name] online by verifying their purchase or ownership, enabling installation without needing the physical CD/DVD.
